name: knos_passkey
docs: A wallet from a passkey: an account whose only authority is a WebAuthn (P-256) assertion, verified by Solana's secp256r1 precompile (SIMD-0075).
Upgradeable only through a multisig with a public 48-hour delay, until an outside review.
A native program: this file is written by hand from programs-v2/knos_passkey/src/lib.rs (its header lists every instruction and the account) and checked by tests/test_passkey_chain.py.
Instruction data is the discriminant byte, then the arguments in order, little-endian, with no padding. A `bytes` argument runs to the end of the data.
The wallet's money is in ordinary token accounts whose owner is the wallet's address (its associated token account for a mint); whoever pays the wallet creates them.

Withdraw must come right after an instruction of Secp256r1SigVerify1111111111111111111111111 that verifies exactly one signature, with the key, the signature and the message in that instruction's own data:

count u8 = 1, padding u8, then u16 LE signature offset, 0xFFFF, key offset, 0xFFFF, message offset, message length, 0xFFFF; the key is the wallet's 33-byte compressed key, the signature r || s with s <= n/2,
the message authenticatorData || sha256(clientDataJSON). The clientDataJSON's type must be webauthn.get and its challenge the unpadded base64url of
sha256("knos-passkey" || wallet || mint || to || amount u64 LE || nonce u64 LE). authenticatorData must have the user-present flag set.

Fund (1.1) is checked the same way, over its own challenge: the unpadded base64url of sha256("knos-passkey:fund" || knos_pay id || mint || the FundOrderWallet instruction data || expirySlot u64 LE || nonce u64 LE).

Fund's data after the discriminant: expirySlot u64, nonce u64, clientLen u16, clientDataJSON [clientLen], then the whole instruction data of knos_pay's FundOrderWallet (shown below as two `bytes` arguments; only the second runs to the end).

instructions.name: Open
docs: Anyone creates the wallet of a passkey, with nonce 0, and pays its rent. A wallet that is open already is left as it is. Needed once, before the first Withdraw; the address can be paid before.

instructions.name: Withdraw
docs: Moves amount of mint from a token account of the wallet to the token account `to`, on the passkey's assertion for exactly that. Nobody signs this instruction: anyone may send it and pay the fee.
nonce must be the wallet's nonce plus one and becomes the wallet's nonce. Nothing is created and no lamports leave the wallet.

A Token-2022 mint with an extension other than MintCloseAuthority, ConfidentialTransferMint, InterestBearingConfig, MetadataPointer, TokenMetadata, GroupPointer, TokenGroup, GroupMemberPointer, TokenGroupMember, ConfidentialMintBurn or ScaledUiAmount is refused.

accounts.name: from
accounts.desc: A token account of the mint owned by the wallet (its associated token account)

accounts.name: to
accounts.desc: The destination token account: the one the challenge names

accounts.name: tokenProgram
accounts.desc: SPL Token or Token-2022: the mint's owner

instructions.name: Fund
docs: 1.1. A funder with only a passkey funds a knos_pay work order: the wallet signs one FundOrderWallet of the knos_pay this program is pinned to, with the very bytes the passkey signed for, and nothing else. Nobody signs this instruction: anyone may send it and pay the fee.

nonce must be the wallet's nonce plus one (the counter Withdraw uses) and becomes the wallet's nonce; the slot must not be after expirySlot. Money: the order's amount plus knos_pay's fee, from -> ov; what left is logged, no fee is computed here.

The wallet holds data, so it cannot pay rent: whoever sends the transaction sends the rent of `order` and of `ov` to those addresses first. When the order closes, knos_pay returns that rent to the wallet.

accounts.name: from
accounts.desc: A token account of the mint owned by the wallet (its associated token account)

accounts.name: order
accounts.desc: The knos_pay order this FundOrderWallet creates, with the wallet as its funder

accounts.name: ov
accounts.desc: The order's own token account, of knos_pay

accounts.name: tokenProgram
accounts.desc: SPL Token or Token-2022: the mint's owner

accounts.name: knosPay
accounts.desc: The knos_pay program this build is pinned to

accounts.name: Wallet
docs: PDA ["pk", sha256(key)]: the wallet of a passkey. 48 bytes. version is 1. key: the passkey's P-256 public key, SEC1 compressed.
nonce: the nonce of the last withdrawal (0: none yet); the next Withdraw must carry nonce + 1.

errors.name: Accounts
errors.msg: a wrong account, or a missing signature

errors.name: Key
errors.msg: not a compressed P-256 public key

errors.name: Wallet
errors.msg: not a wallet of this program

errors.name: Precompile
errors.msg: the instruction before this one is not one secp256r1 verification of its own data

errors.name: Signer
errors.msg: the signature verified is another key's, not this wallet's

errors.name: Message
errors.msg: what was signed is not authenticatorData || sha256(this clientDataJSON)

errors.name: Present
errors.msg: the authenticator did not report that a person was present

errors.name: ClientData
errors.msg: the client data is not that of a webauthn.get with a challenge

errors.name: Challenge
errors.msg: the challenge is not the one for this wallet, mint, destination, amount and nonce

errors.name: Nonce
errors.msg: the nonce is not the wallet's nonce plus one

errors.name: Mint
errors.msg: the mint or the token program is not accepted

errors.name: HighS
errors.msg: the signature's s is in the upper half of the curve order

errors.name: From
errors.msg: from is not a token account of this mint owned by the wallet, or is the destination

errors.name: Expired
errors.msg: the slot is past the expiry slot the passkey signed for

errors.name: Fund
errors.msg: not a FundOrderWallet instruction of the pinned knos_pay
